# sum-odd
Implement `sum_odd` in `sum_odd.py`. Python 3.11+ standard library only.

Input values is an exact built-in list of at most 1000 exact built-in ints in [-1000000000,1000000000]. Return the exact int sum of odd values (including negative values and duplicates); empty input returns 0. Output sums may exceed the input magnitude bound.

Reject bool and all subclasses, including nested values, with exact TypeError. Validate ALL types first; bounds violations then raise exact ValueError. Exception messages are unconstrained. No input mutation, retained state, I/O or dependencies.

Examples (argument lists -> result):
- `[[]]` -> `0`
- `[[1, 2, 3, 4]]` -> `4`
- `[[-3, -2, -1, 0, 2]]` -> `-4`
- `[[2, 2, 3, 3]]` -> `6`
